w:r.w:t: AfriHealth AI Benchmark Corpus: Complete Clinical Code-Switched Test Cases (CS-01 to CS-100)
This comprehensive benchmark corpus contains 100 clinical code-switched test cases (CS-01 to CS-100) designed to rigorously evaluate and stress-test ASR models across Amharic and English.
"ሕመምተኛው ለ 3 ቀን high-grade fever እና severe ሳል አለው።"
"ሕፃኑ ትንፋሽ ማጠር እና wheezing ስላለው nebulization ያስፈልገዋል።"
"Dysuria እና lower abdominal pain ስላለው፣ check urine analysis."
"Fasting blood sugar 240 mg/dL ስለሆነ Metformin 500mg BID እናዘዝ።"
Focus: Fasting blood sugar, Metformin, BID
"BP 160/100 mmHg ነው። Bilateral lower extremity edema ስላለ Echocardiogram እና LFT, RFT order እናድርግ።"
"ሕመምተኛው chills, rigor እና intermittent fever አለው። Blood film for Malaria species እና CBC check እንሥራ።"
Focus: Chills, Rigor, Malaria film, CBC
"Gravida 3 Para 2 at 38 weeks gestation. Regular uterine contractions እና ruptured membranes ስላሉ Plan for normal vaginal delivery."
"Right lower quadrant rebound tenderness ስላለ acute appendicitis rule out ለማድረግ Abdominal ultrasound እና WBC count order እንስጥ።"
"ለ 3 ሳምንት የቆየ chronic cough, night sweats እና weight loss ስላለው GeneXpert for TB እና Chest X-ray order እናድርግ።"
"severe vomiting እና watery diarrhea ስላለ Signs of severe dehydration ታይቷል፤ IV Normal Saline bolus እንስጥ።"
"Involved in RTA with loss of consciousness for 10 minutes. Urgent Head CT scan እና cervical spine X-ray order አድርግ።"
Focus: RTA, Head CT scan, Cervical X-ray
"Generalized maculopapular rash እና severe pruritus ስላለው Discontinue Ceftriaxone immediately, give IV Hydrocortisone."
"Severe headache, neck stiffness እና photophobia ስላለው Kernig's sign positive ነው። Rule out Bacterial Meningitis with Lumbar Puncture."
Batch 2: Cases 16 to 30 (Emergency, Pediatrics, Endo, Card, Infectious)
"ሕመምተኛው ከፍ ያለ የትራፊክ አደጋ ደርሶበት የመኪና ውስጥ ጉዳት ስላለው፣ urgent head CT scan እና cervical spine X-ray ወዲያውኑ order አድርጉልኝ፡፡"
Focus: Trauma, Head CT, Cervical X-ray
"በመኪና አደጋ ምክንያት አጠቃላይ የንቃተ ህሊና ማጣት ለ 20 ደቂቃዎች ያህል አጋጥሞታል፣ ስለዚህ ቆይቶ neurological examination እና IV line ማስተካከል እንጀምራለን፡፡"
Focus: Loss of consciousness, Neurological exam
"ከፍተኛ የሆነ የደም መፍሰስ በግራ እጁ ላይ ስላለ፣ pressure dressing አድርገን ወዲያውኑ CBC እና blood typing መሥራት አለብን።"
"ሕፃኑ የ 2 ዓመት ልጅ ሲሆን ለ 3 ቀናት የሚቆይ ከባድ ሳል እና wheezing አለው፣ ስለዚህ nebulization ከ salbutamol ጋር አሁን እንሰጠዋለን።"
"ልጁ የማስታወክ እና watery diarrhea ምልክቶች ስላሉት፣ acute dehydration ሊሆን ስለሚችል IV Normal Saline bolus ጀምርለት።"
Focus: Diarrhea, Acute dehydration, NS bolus
"ለዚህ የ 3 ዓመት ሕፃን tonsillitis ሕመም Amoxicillin suspension 250mg PO TID ለ 7 ቀናት አዘዝኩለት።"
"የዛሬው ምርመራ ላይ fasting blood sugar 260 mg/dL ስለሆነ፣ Metformin 1000mg BID አስተካክለን እንቀጥላለን፡፡"
"ታካሚው ከፍተኛ ራስ ምታት እና Kussmaul breathing ስላለው፣ immediate random blood sugar እና urine ketones check ማድረግ አለብን።"
Focus: Kussmaul breathing, Blood sugar, Ketones
"የታካሚው የአንገት እብጠት እና palpitation እየጨመረ ስለመጣ፣ TSH እና free T4 lab test order አድርግ።"
Focus: Neck swelling, TSH, Free T4
"የደም ግፊቱ 180 በ 110 mmHg ደርሷል፣ እና ከባድ ራስ ምታት አለው፣ ስለዚህ Enalapril sublingually እንሰጣለን፡፡"
"በሁለቱም እግሮቹ ላይ bilateral pitting edema እና shortness of breath ስላለው፣ Echocardiogram እና Chest X-ray አሳይ።"
Focus: Pitting edema, Shortness of breath, Echo
"በግራ በኩል የሚሰማውን crushing chest pain እና sweating ስላስተዋልን፣ immediate 12-lead ECG እና troponin test እናድርግ።"
Focus: Crushing chest pain, ECG, Troponin
"ለ 4 ሳምንታት የሚቆይ chronic cough, night sweats እና weight loss ስላለው፣ GeneXpert for TB ፈተና እንልካለን፡፡"
"የሰውነቱ ሙቀት ከፍ ያለ እና intermittent fever ከ chills ጋር ስላለው፣ blood film for malaria parasites እና CBC እናዘዝ።"
Focus: Intermittent fever, Chills, Malaria film
"Chest X-ray ላይ consolidation እና crackles ስላሉ Ceftriaxone 1g IV BID እና Azithromycin 500mg PO ጀምርለት።"
Batch 3: Cases 31 to 45 (OBGYN, Derm, Neuro, GI, Outpatient)
"ይህች እናት Gravida 4, Para 3 ስትሆን አሁን በ 38 weeks gestation ላይ regular uterine contractions አሏት።"
"Blood pressure 160/110mmHg እና proteinuria +3 ስለታየ immediate magnesium sulfate protocol እንጀምራለን።"
"የማህፀን በር ከፍቱ 8 ሴንቲሜትር ደርሷል፣ membranes ruptured ስለሆኑ፣ ወደ labor ward እናስገባታለን።"
"በመድኃኒት አለርጂ ምክንያት generalized maculopapular rash እና severe pruritus አለው፣ ስለዚህ Ceftriaxone ወዲያውኑ discontinue እንድርግ።"
"የከንፈር ማበጥ (lip swelling) እና urticaria በመላ አካሉ ላይ ስላለ፣ IV Hydrocortisone 100mg እና Chlorpheniramine እንሰጣለን።"
"ከባድ ራስ ምታት፣ neck stiffness እና photophobia ስላለው Kernig's sign positive ሆኗል፤ ስለዚህ lumbar puncture እናደርጋለን፡፡"
Focus: Meningitis, Kernig's sign, Lumbar puncture
"የቀኝ እጁ እና እግሩ ድክመት (left hemiparesis) እና slurred speech በአንድ ሰዓት ውስጥ አጋጥሞታል፣ ወዲያውኑ non-contrast brain CT scan እናዘዝ።"
Focus: Hemiparesis, Slurred speech, Brain CT
"በቀኝ የታችኛው የሆድ ክፍል (right lower quadrant) severe tenderness እና rebound tenderness ስላለ፣ acute appendicitis rule out እንድርግ።"
Focus: Right lower quadrant tenderness, Appendicitis
"Dysuria እና frequent urination ከ lower back pain ጋር ስላለው urinalysis እና urine culture እናዘዝ።"
"ብዙ ጊዜ የሚያስታውከና watery diarrhea ያለው ታካሚ ስለሆነ፣ stool analysis እና IV fluid resuscitation እንጀምራለን፡፡"
Focus: Watery diarrhea, Stool analysis, IV fluids
"Chronic back pain ስላለው Tramadol 50mg PO BID ለ 5 ቀናት ብቻ አዘዝኩለት።"
"Gastritis እና heartburn ስላለው Omeprazole 20mg PO daily ከbreakfast በፊት 30 ደቂቃ እንዲወስድ እናዘዛለን።"
"Knee joint swelling ስላለው Ibuprofen 400mg PO TID ከምግብ በኋላ አብሮ ከ Omeprazole ጋር እንሰጣለን።"
"የአፍንጫ ማሳከክ፣ sneezing እና watery discharge ባለበት ታካሚ ላይ Cetirizine 10mg PO daily እናዘዝ።"
"የደም ማነስ (anemia) ምልክቶች እና pale conjunctiva ስለታየበት Ferrous Sulfate 200mg PO TID ከ Vitamin C ጋር እናዘዝ።"
Focus: Anemia, Pale conjunctiva, Ferrous sulfate
Batch 4: Cases 46 to 60 (Psychiatry, Ortho, Ophthalmology, ENT, Oncology, Emergency)
"ታካሚው ባለፉት ሁለት ሳምንታት ውስጥ depressed mood, insomnia እና suicidal ideation ስላለው immediate psychiatric evaluation እና PHQ-9 assessment እንሰራለን።"
"Acute anxiety ከ palpitation, shortness of breath እና chest tightness ስላለው፣ panic attack ሊሆን ስለሚችል Lorazepam 1mg sublingually እንሰጣለን።"
"የቀኝ እግር tibia shaft fracture ስላለበት፣ closed reduction አድርገን above-knee plaster cast እናድርግ።"
Focus: Tibia fracture, Reduction, Plaster cast
"Acute glaucoma ስላለ severe ocular pain, blurred vision እና halos around lights ስላለው immediate intraocular pressure check እና Timolol eye drops order እንድርግ።"
Focus: Acute glaucoma, Ocular pain, Timolol
"የቀኝ earache እና otorrhea ባለበት ህፃን ላይ Amoxicillin-Clavulanate suspension 400mg PO BID ለ 10 ቀናት እናዘዛለን።"
"የታካሚው serum creatinine እና BUN እያደጉ ስለመጡ፣ estimated GFR calculate አድርገን nephrology consultation እንጠይቃለን።"
"ከሁለተኛው ዙር chemotherapy በኋላ severe nausea እና vomiting ስላለው፣ Ondansetron 8mg IV slow push እንሰጣለን፡፡"
"የ 78 ዓመት አዛውንት በቤት ውስጥ ስለወደቁ፣ hip X-ray order አድርገን neurological status check እንከታተላለን፡፡"
"ከቀዶ ጥገናው በኋላ በቁስሉ አካባቢ redness, warmth እና purulent discharge ስላለው፣ wound swab for culture እንልካለን።"
Focus: Surgical site infection, Wound swab
"Acute bronchospasm እና severe wheezing ስላለው Salbutamol nebulization ከ Ipratropium bromide ጋር በአስቸኳይ እንጀምራለን።"
"Irregular pulse እና irregularly irregular rhythm ECG ላይ ስለታየ Metoprolol 50mg PO BID ለ rate control እንጀምራለን።"
"Unilateral throbbing headache ከ nausea እና photophobia ጋር ስላለው Sumatriptan 50mg PO as needed for acute attack እናዘዝ።"
"የክብደት መጨመር፣ cold intolerance እና dry skin ስላለው፣ Levothyroxine dosage adjust ለማድረግ TSH እና free T4 እናዘዝ።"
"Hypotension እና tachycardia ስላለው immediate blood cultures ተቀብጠን IV broad-spectrum antibiotics እና 30ml/kg fluid bolus እንጀምራለን።"
"Total body surface area second-degree burn injury ስላለው Parkland formula በመጠቀም IV Ringer's Lactate resuscitation እና calculated analgesia እንጀምራለን።"
Focus: Burn injury, Parkland formula, Resuscitation
Batch 5: Cases 61 to 75 (Tropical Diseases, Rheumatology & Pulmonology)
"ታካሚው ለ 7 ቀናት የሚቆይ high fever, joint pain (arthralgia) እና retro-orbital pain ስላለው፣ Dengue fever serology እና CBC check እናድርግ።"
Focus: Dengue fever, Arthralgia, Retro-orbital pain
"በግራ ጉልበቱ ላይ acute swelling, severe pain እና warmth ስላለ፣ septic arthritis rule out ለማድረግ knee joint aspiration እና synovial fluid analysis order እናድርግ።"
"የተቃጠለ ወይም የደነዘዘ የቆዳ ቁስል (hypopigmented patch with sensory loss) ስላለው፣ leprosy (Hansen's disease) suspect አድርገን skin slit smear እንልካለን።"
"ለወራት የቆየ dry cough እና progressive shortness of breath በ exertion ስላለው፣ high-resolution computed tomography (HRCT) chest እና pulmonary function test order እናድርግ።"
Focus: HRCT chest, Dyspnea on exertion
"የመገጣጠሚያ ህመም በተለይ በ (morning stiffness) ከ 1 ሰዓት በላይ የሚቆይባቸው አዛውንት ስለሆኑ፣ Rheumatoid factor እና Anti-CCP test እናዘዝ።"
"በግራ እግሩ tibia/fibula አካባቢ chronic bone infection (osteomyelitis) ስላለበት፣ deep bone biopsy for culture and sensitivity order እናድርግ።"
"ከባድ የጡንቻ ህመም (myalgia) እና dark-colored urine (myoglobinuria) ከ statin use በኋላ ስላጋጠመው፣ immediate serum creatine kinase (CK) level check እናድርግ።"
"በግራ flank region ላይ የሚወጣ painful vesicular rash በጥንታዊ zoster (Herpes Zoster) መልክ ስላለው፣ Acyclovir 800mg 5 times daily ጀምርለት።"
"የታካሚው ፕሌትሌት ቁጥር (platelet count) በጣም ዝቅተኛ ስለሆነ እና spontaneous mucosal bleeding ስላለው፣ immediate hematology consultation እና platelet transfusion order እናድርግ።"
"ከባድ የጉሮሮ ህመም (severe pharyngitis) ከ exudates ጋር እና cervical lymphadenopathy ስላለው፣ throat swab for rapid strep test እንወስዳለን።"
"በቀኝ upper quadrant abdominal pain ከ fever እና jaundice ጋር (Charcot's triad) ስላለው፣ acute cholangitis suspect አድርገን abdominal ultrasound እና IV antibiotics እንጀምራለን።"
"የመተንፈሻ አካል ችግር እና acute exacerbation of COPD ስላለው፣ Duolin (Salbutamol + Ipratropium) nebulization እና systemic corticosteroids 40mg PO ጀምር።"
"ለረጅም ጊዜ በ bedridden ሁኔታ የቆየ ታካሚ ስለሆነ፣ sacral pressure ulcer stage III ስላለበት wound debridement እና daily dressing change order እናድርግ።"
"በግራ እጁ ላይ sudden loss of sensation እና pallor ስላለው፣ acute limb ischemia rule out ለማድረግ urgent Doppler ultrasound order እናድርግ።"
